- `word_count("one\ntwo\tthree")` returns 1 instead of 3.
- `word_count("")` returns 1 instead of 0.
- `most_common_word("one  two  three  two")` returns an empty string instead of "two".

The `tokenize` function currently splits the text using only spaces as separators and does not handle newlines or tabs correctly.
